answer: Your garbage should be thrown in the bin bags provided and taken to the trash room at the end of the corridor on your floor. The trash room is collected from the trash rooms every morning between 7:00 AM and 8:00 AM. Bin bags are refilled free at the front desk.

1. Switch off the AC, the geyser, lights and fans.
2. Close and lock windows and balcony doors.
3. Take all rubbish to the trash room on your floor (section 9.4).
4. Leave used towels on the bathroom floor.
5. Sign out of the TV streaming apps (section 5.2).
6. Close the door firmly; it locks automatically.
